evidence.note: Authentication record declares OAuth with StartLogin, FinishLogin and Refresh; no anonymous, key or other kind.
Authorization request has response_type code, state and client_id, with no code_challenge or code_verifier.
Exchanges refresh_token for a new token using grant_type refresh_token.
No PKCE parameters are sent; the token exchange uses a client_secret hash instead (lines 78-97).
Implements token refresh with grant_type refresh_token.
All data requests go through Web.Contents(url, [Headers, ManualStatusHandling, IsRetry]) at line 249.
The user picks US or EU by name from an enum (RegionCode values), which is a region choice.
The endpoint parameter is a resource path such as sheets/{id} or reports/{id} that names a resource inside the target.
args (raw query-string fragment such as pageSize=) and headers (record passed straight through to Web.Contents) are covered by other.
options is an optional connector-settings record, and Contents takes options as well.

options-fields.text: The options record accepts MaxRetries (number, clamped to 1-2, default 1; used at line 240) and ReportPageSize (number, clamped to 500-10000, default 1000; used at line 330). Other fields are ignored.

evidence.note: MaxRetries is read from options and bounded to 1-2.
ReportPageSize is read from options and bounded to 500-10000.
Pages are requested by page number (page=i+1) with a fixed pageSize.
The connector calls List.Generate directly to fetch pages; Table.GenerateByPage is not used.

paging-stop.text: Paging stops when the page index times pageSize is no longer less than raw[totalRowCount], which is the List.Generate continuation condition. Sheets are not paged because the API returns all rows in one response.

evidence.note: Continuation condition [i] * pageSize < raw[totalRowCount].
Comment states no paging is needed for the sheets endpoint.
Returned response body is parsed with Json.Document.
Column names come from the API column titles through Table.FromRows, and no M types are assigned.
Report column names come from the API titles through Table.FromRows, with no declared types or type conversion.
Data requests set ManualStatusHandling and inspect Response.Status against the retry list.
Retry driver: failed requests are re-issued through Function.InvokeAfter with a delay.
Computes the delay between attempts with exponential backoff and jitter.
429 (Too Many Requests) is in the retried status list. This is the only rate-limit handling, and Retry-After is not honored.

retry-rule.text: Retried statuses: 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504, 509. Attempts = 1 + MaxRetries, where MaxRetries defaults to 1 and is clamped to 1-2, so 2 or 3 attempts in total. The first attempt has no delay. Retry delays use ExponentialBackoff(n) = 2^n seconds with about +/-50% random jitter (n = 1 gives about 2-4 s, n = 2 gives about 3-7 s). Retry-After is not honored.

evidence.note: maxAttempts = 1 + clamped MaxRetries; the retried status list.
Iteration 0 has no delay; delay = RoundDown(2^n + 1 + random(-2^n/2, 2^n/2)) seconds.
Documentation.Description, DisplayName, Caption, Name, LongDescription and Examples are set.
Parameters have Documentation.FieldCaption and Documentation.FieldDescription.
Documentation.SampleValues is set for endpoint (also line 600 for args).
Documentation.AllowedValues is set to the US and EU enum values, which makes a dropdown.
Root nodes are built at runtime from the live folders/personal and workspaces responses.
Folder rows have IsLeaf false and lazily open a further navigation table.
Workspace rows have IsLeaf false and lazily open a further navigation table.
TestConnection returns {"SmartsheetGlobal.Contents", region}, which names the shared Contents entry function, so the test runs a normal navigation query.
The whole connector is in one .pq file with no pqm modules or LoadExpression helpers.
ButtonText uses Extension.LoadString, so the strings are localized.
Icons are loaded with Extension.Contents from PNG files.
Diagnostics.Trace at Information level runs on retry and failure, with no switch.
Diagnostics.Trace warnings run ungated during live clamping, reached from GetMaxRetries and GetReportPageSize.
